items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I saw a girl -- Nellie Lutcher. I saw her at the Cookery on TV, on a newsskit. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes, and Rose Murphy.

ctx.x: And Beryl Booker and there was another -- McKay, a piano player, her last name was McKay -- Claudia --
I saw a girl -- Nellie Lutcher. I saw her at the Cookery on TV, on a newsskit.
